params.name: iccid
params.description: The iccid of the SIM in question.

params.name: subscriber
params.description: Flag indicating if the subscriber information should be retrieved. Default value is true.

params.name: ussd
params.description: Flag for retrieving the USSD connectivity info. Default value is false.

items.docs: Retrieve connectivity information and cell tower of a device with a given SIM. The API call returns valid information when the 1NCE SIM is attached to a 2G/3G network only.

params.name: iccid
params.description: The ICCID of the SIM to be reset.

items.docs: Trigger a connectivity reset for a given SIM. The actual reset will be done asynchronously. A positive-response only means that the connectivity-reset has been successfully placed into the queue.
